item.title: Mat Sadler disappointed with home defeat to MK Dons
item.description: Head Coach Mat Sadler reflected on the defeat to MK Dons on Monday night with a sense of disappointment as his side fell to a 2-0 loss at the Pallet-Track Bescot Stadium. The Saddlers were trailing at the break after a goal on the half-hour mark and a second goal sealed victory for the visitors late on. item.title: Willis satisfied with gritty performance in Telford victory
item.description: Walsall Women Head Coach Matt Willis was satisfied with his side’s gritty performance in their 3-1 win over AFC Telford United at Dales Lane. Mia Fellows’ brace gave the Saddlers an early lead, which was halved by Abi Beady in the second half, before Phoebe Smith nodded in the third to relieve any pressure on the Black Country outfit. item.title: 2024/25 Annual Accounts Summary
item.description: The Club has today (Friday 27th February 2026) filed our financial statements for the year ended 31st May 2025 at Companies House. This report outlines the Club’s financial position as of 31st May 2025 and covers the 2024/25 season in Sky Bet League Two. The 2024/25 financial year showed a mix of both positive growth in respect of our revenues, along with significant headwinds and challenges associated with costs across the business. item.title: Smith proud of team for extending unbeaten run
item.description: Walsall Women captain Phoebe Smith took pride in her side’s professional performance in their 3-1 win over AFC Telford United Women on Sunday afternoon. Mia Fellows’ first half brace gave the Saddlers a comfortable lead, until Abi Beady pulled one back after the restart. However, Smith’s header late on wrapped up the three points at Dales Lane. item.title: Pre-match: Sadler looking for upturn in momentum ahead of weekend clash
item.description: Head Coach Mat Sadler has said how he’s looking for an upturn in momentum from his squad this weekend as Walsall continue with League Two action, this time on the road against local rivals Shrewsbury Town. item.title: Gary Waddock departs for Wealdstone
item.description: We can confirm that Assistant Head Coach Gary Waddock has departed the club to join National League side Wealdstone as their new Manager. Gary joined the Saddlers in June 2023 and has been a key part of Mat Sadler's backroom staff ever since, providing invaluable guidance and experience along the way and showcasing his knowledge of the game in abundance.
